questions.question: Sami asks Mina: 'What is the key to a successful composite restoration?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Adhesion is the key to success. Without good adhesion, even the best composite will fail.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will focus on adhesion.'

questions.question: Sami asks Mina: 'How to choose between a total-etch and a self-etch system?' Mina answers:
options: The choice depends on the clinical situation and the substrate
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Total-etch is more effective on enamel, self-etch is simpler on dentin.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will adapt my choice to the situation.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'Why do my composites sometimes discolor?' Mina answers him:
options: It's a polishing defect or absorption of dyes
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A poorly polished surface absorbs food dyes.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take care of my polishing.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to avoid post-operative sensitivity?' Mina advises him to:
options: Increase the power of the lamp
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A dentin liner protects the pulp from stimuli.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always put a liner.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss composites. Mina says: 'Nanohybrids offer better polishability.' Sami asks: 'What is the disadvantage of nanohybrids?'
options: They are more sensitive to moisture
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Nanohybrids are more technical and sensitive to moisture.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will ensure perfect isolation.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is layering in composite?' Mina explains to him:
options: A technique of applying successive layers of different shades
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Layering reproduces the natural structure of the tooth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will learn layering.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When to use a glass ionomer rather than a composite?' Mina answers:
options: For root caries or baby teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Glass ionomer is indicated for root caries and baby teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use glass ionomer for roots.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to evaluate the quality of adhesion?' Mina answers him:
options: By checking the absence of leakage and retention
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The absence of leakage and good retention are signs of good adhesion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the sealing.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss polishing. Mina says: 'Final polishing is crucial.' Sami asks: 'Why?'
options: To reduce plaque and improve longevity
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Good polishing reduces plaque accumulation and prolongs the life of the restoration.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will polish systematically.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a bulk-fill composite?' Mina explains to him:
options: A composite that polymerizes deeply in a single layer
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Bulk-fill composites allow restoring deep cavities in a single layer.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use bulk-fill to save time.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a cavity under a crown?' Mina answers him:
options: Assess the accessibility and size of the cavity
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'If the cavity is accessible, a repair is possible without remaking the crown.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will assess before deciding.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the difference between an inlay and an onlay?' Mina answers:
options: The onlay covers the cusps, the inlay does not
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The onlay is more conservative than a crown and reinforces the cusps.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose an onlay for this fracture.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss materials. Mina says: 'Amalgam still has indications.' Sami asks: 'Which ones?'
options: Class I and II cavities on posterior teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Amalgam is still indicated for certain posterior cavities.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will keep amalgam in my toolbox.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to protect the pulp from a deep cavity?' Mina advises him:
options: Wait for the cavity to progress
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Calcium hydroxide protects the pulp and promotes reparative dentin.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use a pulp capping.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'Why do my composites sometimes fracture?' Mina answers him:
options: It's a lack of thickness or poor design
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Insufficient thickness or poor preparation leads to fracture.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take care of my preparations.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is recurrent caries?' Mina explains to him:
options: A cavity that appears around a restoration
A new cavity on a healthy tooth
A cavity that recurs after endodontic treatment
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Recurrent caries are often related to sealing defects.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take care of my marginal finishes.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss ceramics. Mina says: 'Ceramic inlays are aesthetic.' Sami asks: 'What is their disadvantage?'
options: They are more difficult to place
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Ceramic inlays are more expensive and technical.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will offer a ceramic inlay to this patient.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to choose the shade of a composite?' Mina advises him:
options: With a shade guide under neutral light
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A shade guide under neutral light is the reliable method.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will invest in a good shade guide.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When to repair rather than redo a restoration?' Mina answers him:
options: If the cavity is small and the restoration functional
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Repairs are indicated for small recurrent caries.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will repair when possible.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage post-operative sensitivity?' Mina advises him:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Sensitivity is often due to leakage or insufficient adhesion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the sealing of my restoration.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss the future of composites. Mina says: 'Composites will evolve.' Sami asks: 'Towards what?'
options: More resistant and more aesthetic composites
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The evolution of composites is towards more resistance and aesthetics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will follow innovations.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the golden rule in conservative dentistry?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Preservation of tooth structure is the basis of our discipline.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always prioritize conservation.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to improve the longevity of my composites?' Mina advises him:
options: Use a quality adhesive and polish well
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A good adhesive and careful polishing prolong the lifespan.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take care of these two steps.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a marginal bevel?' Mina explains to him:
options: A bevel on the enamel to improve adhesion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The bevel improves the aesthetic transition and sealing.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always make a bevel.'

questions.question: Sami, after mastering materials with Mina, says: 'I am ready to take on all challenges!' Mina concludes: 'Mastering materials is...'
options: The foundation of success in conservative dentistry
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mastering materials is the foundation of success in conservative dentistry.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to train.'
